verdict.rationale: Column publishes an OpenAPI spec and markdown docs (docs.column.com) plus a sandbox environment with simulate endpoints for testing payment flows, which supports some hands-on exploration, but there is no direct evidence of an interactive in-docs API console or embedded runnable code examples typical of 'try it now' reference UIs. missing for 10: explicit interactive API explorer/try-it-out UI, embedded runnable code snippets, independent confirmation of an interactive reference experience.
